title: Dithiocarbazate Ligand-Based Cu(II), Ni(II), and Zn(II) Complexes: Synthesis, Structural Investigations, Cytotoxicity, DNA Binding, and Molecular Docking Studies.
authors: Yusof, Enis Nadia Md; Azam, Mohammad; Sirat, Siti Syaida; Ravoof, Thahira B S A; Page, Alister J; Veerakumarasivam, Abhi; Karunakaran, Thiruventhan; Razali, Mohd Rizal
one_liner_zh: 该研究合成并表征了二硫代氨基甲酸酯配体及其Cu/Ni/Zn配合物，通过电子吸收法和分子对接初步考察了与CT-DNA的结合能力，但对象为小分子金属配合物而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法仅涉及简单对接，缺乏TF-DNA体系与AI/物理模拟深度。
abstract: S-4-methylbenzyl-beta-N-(2-methoxybenzylmethylene)dithiocarbazate ligand, 1, prepared from S-(4-methylbenzyl)dithiocarbazate, was used to produce a novel series of transition metal complexes of the type, [M (L)(2)] [M = Cu(II) (2), Ni(II) (3), and Zn(II) (4), L = 1]. The ligand and its complexes were investigated by elemental analysis, FTIR, (1)H and (13)C-NMR, MS spectrometry, and molar conductivity. In addition, single X-ray crystallography was also performed for ligand, 1, and complex 3. The Hirshfeld surface analyses were also performed to know about various bonding interactions in the ligand, 1, and complex 3. The investigated compounds were also tested to evaluate their cytotoxic behaviour. However, complex 2 showed promising results against MCF-7 and MDA-MB-213 cancer cell lines. Furthermore, the interaction of CT-DNA with ligand, 1, and complex 2 was also studied using the electronic absorption method, revealing that the compounds have potential DNA-binding ability via hydrogen bonding and hydrophobic and van der Waals interactions. A molecular docking study of complex 2 was also carried out, which revealed that free binding free energy value was -7.39 kcal mol(-1).
abstract_zh: 以S-(4-甲基苄基)二硫代卡巴肼为原料制备的S-4-甲基苄基-β-N-(2-甲氧基苄基亚甲基)二硫代卡巴肼配体1，用于合成一系列新型过渡金属配合物，其通式为[M(L)2][M = Cu(II) (2), Ni(II) (3), 和 Zn(II) (4), L = 1]。通过元素分析、FTIR、1H和13C-NMR、质谱及摩尔电导率对配体及其配合物进行了表征。此外，还对配体1和配合物3进行了单晶X射线晶体学研究。同时进行了Hirshfeld表面分析，以了解配体1和配合物3中的各种键合相互作用。所研究的化合物也进行了细胞毒性评估。然而，配合物2对MCF-7和MDA-MB-213癌细胞系显示出有前景的结果。此外，利用电子吸收法研究了CT-DNA与配体1及配合物2的相互作用，结果表明这些化合物通过氢键、疏水作用和范德华力具有潜在的DNA结合能力。还对配合物2进行了分子对接研究，结果显示其自由结合能值为-7.39 kcal mol(-1)。
